nodes.label: KFV Freising Logo (Dark/Inverse Version)
nodes.description: Dark/inverse version of the KFV Freising (Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising) organizational logo. Wide horizontal SVG format (654.595×139.944 viewBox). Contains approximately 6,790 path elements representing highly detailed vector artwork. Uses white (#fff) fills for text and outlines against dark backgrounds, intended for placement on dark or colored surfaces. Brand colors: fire red (#f80c27, #f60d29, #e31517) for the fire department emblem/badge, white (#fbf7fc, #faf5fc, #fff) for typography and outlines, steel blue-gray (#84a3bb, #7d8da0) for secondary elements, near-black (#050712, #0b1125, #121a2d) for dark fill areas. The 'b' suffix denotes 'dark background' use case (counterpart to Logo_KFV-Freising-w.svg for light backgrounds). Left section (~103×101px clip region) contains the Bavarian fire department emblem with stylized badge/cross motif. Right section contains typography paths spelling out 'Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising'. Used in TYPO3 sitepackage as the inverse logo for dark mode headers and dark-background footers (referenced as {settings.Sitepackage.logoInverse} in Footer.html and as hidden dark:block element in Header.html).

nodes.label: KFV Freising Brand Identity
nodes.description: Brand identity of Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising (KFV Freising), the Fire Department District Association of Freising, Bavaria. Visual brand uses fire red as the primary accent color, consistent with emergency services identity. Logo layout is horizontal with emblem left and full organization name right. Two logo variants exist for light and dark contexts.
